clips.title: The story
paras: In Mulgore, Skorn Whitecloud guides aspiring trackers through the Hunter's Way. To prove their skill and respect for the wild, you hunt flatland prowlers and bring their claws to Melor Stonehoof on Thunder Bluff's Hunter Rise.

For the tauren, hunting is among the highest honors. It calls for patience, attention to the Earth Mother's balance, and respect for the beasts across the plains. Elder Skorn Whitecloud has spent decades tracking across Kalimdor and now rests in Mulgore. He sees young adventurers eager to roam and gives them a traditional trial to shape their ambition into discipline.

Flatland prowlers test a candidate's tracking skill. These great cats move swiftly and quietly, hiding in Mulgore's high grass before ambushing their prey. Bring four sets of claws to show you can spot a predator before it catches you, then turn its ferocity against it.

After gathering the claws, you climb the wooden towers and bridges to Thunder Bluff's Hunter Rise. Melor Stonehoof receives the trophies there. A master tracker who values Skorn Whitecloud's ancient wisdom, Melor accepts them as proof that you have the spirit to learn more of Kalimdor's hunting ways.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are eager to explore, I can tell. I too had the lust to wander, once...
Wander, and hunt. For hunting is a Tauren's greatest honor.
If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path. He is in Thunder Bluff, on the Hunter's Rise.
And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore. They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young adventurer on the hunter's path.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings. There is an air about you that tells me much. Do we have business, you and I?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Skorn Whitecloud is a wise tauren. He has hunted for years and years, and although his body is old, his spirit burns fiercely. We are honored to have him with us.
If Skorn sent you to me, then you too must have the hunter's spirit. And to have gathered these claws shows your burgeoning skills.
Perhaps you are ready to walk the path.
